title: Dermaself takes its AI skin analysis into remote clinical studies
summary: Dermaself's AI already turns a selfie into a personalised skincare routine on brand websites and in stores. The same measurement now lets testing laboratories run efficacy studies on up to 10,000 volunteers who photograph their skin at home. Here is what the technology does, and what brands should ask their lab for next
